remarks: Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Westport, this beautiful timeless Colonial is located at the top of one of the town's most picturesque streets, directly across from the scenic Saugatuck River. The gourmet kitchen features island seating, custom cabinetry, a serving peninsula, and a breakfast room with an abundance of natural light. The front-to-back living room with fireplace and high ceilings is adjacent to the kitchen and is also the heart of the home. Two recently renovated (Trex) decks off the kitchen and living room, along with an expansive terrace, overlook the private backyard-perfect for entertaining and outdoor enjoyment. All bedrooms are located on the second level along with two fully renovated baths. The lower level includes a family room, home gym, full bathroom and a lot of storage. The lower level has potential for a fifth bedroom. Offering 3,674 sq ft of finished living space, 23 Harborview Rd provides both comfort and flexibility, with additional unfinished space to expand within the existing footprint, if desired. Additional highlights include natural gas, public water and sewer, central air, two-car garage with room for storage, and new blue stone front walk. Commuters will appreciate the south of the Post Rd location, just 1.8 miles to the Westport Station. Harborview offers a walkable lifestyle-minutes to town 'over the foot bridge' to the library, Farmer's market, Levitt Pavillion, and restaurants. Audio/Visual
